fields.doc: Ledger timestamp (unix seconds) at which `approve` was called. 0 until approved.
fields.name: approved_at

cases.doc: An escrow with this id already exists.
cases.name: AlreadyExists

cases.doc: No escrow found for this id.
cases.name: NotFound

cases.doc: The escrow is not in the required state for this operation.
cases.name: InvalidStatus

cases.doc: The 48h release delay has not elapsed yet.
cases.name: TooEarly

function_v0.doc: Buyer deposits `amount` of `token` into escrow for `seller`, tracked\nunder `escrow_id`. Transfers the funds from the buyer's wallet into\nthis contract. Requires the buyer's authorization.
function_v0.name: create_escrow

function_v0.doc: Buyer approves the deal. Starts the 48h countdown to auto-release.\nRequires the buyer's authorization.
function_v0.name: approve

function_v0.doc:
Permissionless: releases escrowed funds to the seller once the
buyer has approved AND at least `RELEASE_DELAY_SECS` have passed
since approval. No signature is required from either party for this
call \xe2\x80\x94 only the on-chain time condition is enforced \xe2\x80\x94 so the seller
(or anyone) can always claim once eligible.
function_v0.name: release

function_v0.doc: Buyer reclaims funds, only allowed before approval (i.e. before the\ncountdown has started). Requires the buyer's authorization.
function_v0.name: cancel_escrow

function_v0.doc: Read-only lookup of an escrow's current state.
function_v0.name: get_escrow

function_v0.doc: Seconds remaining before `release` becomes callable. 0 if already\neligible or not yet approved/found in a releasable state.
function_v0.name: seconds_until_release
